Our Studio

A room built for slowing down.

STILLWATER is a yoga and wellness studio for people who want to move with intention. Every class is instructor-led, every pose is offered with options, and every student is met where they are that day.

Classes

Practice with a purpose

VINYASA

Flow & Strength

A dynamic, breath-linked sequence that builds heat and moves continuously from pose to pose.

HATHA

Foundations

Slower-paced postural work focused on alignment, breath, and building a steady foundation.

YIN

Deep Release

Long-held floor poses that work into connective tissue and calm the nervous system.

PRANAYAMA

Meditation & Breathwork

Seated practice built around breath control, stillness, and quieting a busy mind.
